text: Appeal of Order to Comply for 9 Greentree Court, Unit 11.

The Property Standards Committee, Etobicoke York Panel: 1. Amended the Order to Comply, dated October 8, 2018, regarding the property located at 9 Greentree Court, Unit 11, to add Section 5.B. to Item 1. 2. Confirmed the Order to Comply, dated September 26, 2018, regarding the property located at 9 Greentree Court, Unit 11, and in doing so granted an extension of time to March 15, 2019.
